description: McDonnell Douglas RF-4E Phantom II, in Turkish Ministry of National Defence service from 1993 to 2007, moved from Eskisehir and installed over eight days at the education centre in May 2021 as an outdoor exhibit. Serial confirmed independently by Turkish press reporting and by the Spottingmode register, which was last revised for this location in June 2022.
